result:
The simulator puts this GEMM at about 23 µs. I did not measure it on hardware.

- **Work:** 2·256·18560·4096 ≈ 38.9 GFLOP. The B-matrix weights are 18560×4096×2 B ≈ 152 MB.
- **Compute floor:** at roughly 2.2 PFLOPS dense BF16, the FLOPs alone take about 17 µs.
- **Memory floor:** 152 MB at about 7–8 TB/s of HBM takes about 19–22 µs. The shape is skinny (M=256), so streaming the weights competes with the tensor-core time.
- **Simulator result:** I ran it on the `hgx_b300_8` preset (a single GPU) with a 300 ns launch gap, as for CUDA-graph replay. It gives 22.9 µs, of which the kernel is 21.9 µs at about 1.79 PFLOPS, with a stated error band of ±13%. The roofline replay of the same program gives 24.3 µs.

I take 23 µs as the best single estimate.
